name: dsh-scheduled-prompt
description: Scheduled-prompt driver for DeepSeek Harness: config-declared cron/interval jobs deliver prompts into the resident agent or fresh one-shot sessions, with per-run step budgets, idempotent tick dedupe, and a durable JSONL run log.

dshCompatibility.note: deepseek-harness is pre-release with no compatibility promise; re-verify against newer commits before upgrading.
